Hi all — saw this first thing. Guidance from tax/compliance: if Nova is UK-registered and submits a signed W-8BEN-E that contains (a) the chapter 3/61 treaty claim language (if they’re claiming treaty), (b) the UBO declaration (names and percent ownership), and (c) a legible signatory name/title/date, we can accept that to avoid backup withholding. Please ensure the form is the latest IRS edition and that the vendor provides the UK tax reference (e.g., UTR or company number) in the entity details section so our tax team can cross-check.

If the vendor cannot provide a complete W-8BEN-E (signed + UBO + tax reference), then the fallback is:
- apply backup withholding at statutory rate and hold payment until documentation is provided, or
- escalate for one-time exception if legal signs off (rare).

Timing: once we receive a compliant W-8BEN-E and confirm the UK tax identifier, pay run will be scheduled in the next AP cycle (within 5 business days).

Sara — please reply with the signed form and the company tax reference. If you prefer, I’ve attached a short checklist of required fields so you can validate before re-upload: payment_release_checklist.pdf.
